groups.groupName: Tier 1 - Safest Choice: Clear Soups & Boiled Greens
groups.comparisonSentence: These steamed and boiled dishes provide significantly lower saturated fat and calories compared to the heavy fried sets and stir-fries.
groups.message: These clear soups and boiled vegetables offer a refreshing, low-fat option that helps close your fiber deficit while keeping sodium and calories under control. They lack the heavy oils found in the fried sets, supporting your metabolic targets.
groups.orderingTip: Request soups with reduced added salt and skip any added fried shallot toppings to keep sodium low.

groups.groupName: Tier 2 - Neutral: Sautéed Vegetables & Lean Staples
groups.comparisonSentence: Compared to the clear soups, these sautéed and staple items introduce moderate cooking oils and higher carbohydrates, requiring portion mindfulness.
groups.message: These dishes provide essential dietary fiber and moderate protein, though they carry higher carbohydrate and oil loads than boiled options. Watch your portion sizes to prevent exceeding your daily carbohydrate and calorie limits.
groups.orderingTip: Ask for stir-fried dishes to be prepared with minimal cooking oil and reduced shrimp paste to limit sodium.

groups.groupName: Tier 3 - Warning: Deep-Fried Meals & Fried Rice
groups.comparisonSentence: These fried items drastically exceed your current sodium and saturated fat thresholds when compared to the steamed or boiled options.
groups.message: Deep-fried meal sets and fried rice contribute significantly to your existing saturated fat and sodium overages. While they deliver high protein, the heavy frying process increases caloric density and metabolic strain.
groups.orderingTip: Opt for grilled protein alternatives instead of fried options, and share the rice portion to manage carbohydrates.

groups.groupName: Tier 4 - Alert: Heavy Fried Snacks & Wet Crackers
